Hello,

Glad that helped, and thanks for saying so. There is always someone here, before and after the sale.

If you want a hand picking a unit, just tell me where you will be running it and roughly what you want out of it, and I will put real numbers next to a couple of options for your area rather than generic ones.

If you were happy with how this went, a short review on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
